summary: Converts three floats from the a2 array into fixed-point fields of the object: a2[0] clamped to the byte range and scaled by the byte multiplier, stored as an 8-bit value at this+0x24; a2[1] clamped to the short range and scaled by the short multiplier, stored as a 16-bit value at this+0x26; a2[2] clamped to the byte range and scaled by the byte multiplier, stored at this+0x25 and returned. Out-of-range values clamp to signed sentinel min/max values.

operations.description: Two-sided range check on a2[0] against the byte-range clamp-bound globals (flt_5ACCA0 / flt_5ACCA4, literal bounds +/-6.3499999); clamp low to -127 and high to 127 when out of range.
Within range, scale a2[0] by the byte multiplier global flt_59E8EC (literal 20.0), truncate to an 8-bit value, and store it at this+0x24.
Two-sided range check on a2[1] against the short-range clamp-bound globals (flt_5ACCA8 / flt_5ACCAC, literal bounds +/-65.533997); clamp low to -32767 and high to 0x7FFF when out of range.
Within range, scale a2[1] by the short multiplier global flt_59E91C (literal 500.0), truncate to a 16-bit value, and store it at this+0x26.
Two-sided range check on a2[2] against the same byte-range clamp bounds (literal +/-6.3499999); clamp low to -127 and high to 127 when out of range.
Within range, scale a2[2] by the byte multiplier (literal 20.0), truncate to an 8-bit value, store it at this+0x25, and use the same value as the return result.
Return the clamped/scaled value derived from a2[2].

unresolved: Which clamp-bound global pair serves which range (byte vs short) is inferred from the literal magnitudes; the exact global-to-range mapping needs external evidence.
